snippet.title: We Don't Exist: six subjects enter the red room, two survive (gameplay)
snippet.description:
One room of the free demo of We Don't Exist, a psychological horror game made solo in Godot 4. Six subjects enter, the room only tolerates two.

Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4922750/We_Dont_Exist/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=rampe2026

Music: "Killers" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Music: Eric Matyas, www.soundimage.org

#indiegame #horrorgaming #psychologicalhorror #godot
